# neptune

Amazon Neptune Database and Neptune Analytics - Gremlin/openCypher/SPARQL access, explain/profile plans (non-native steps, unbounded estimates, all-label scans), Analytics algorithms and vector topK, plus cluster encryption posture from dumps.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model neptune --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model neptune-access --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show neptune`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-013, AF-STORE-004, AF-GDB-007, AF-GDB-009, AF-GDB-010, AF-GDB-020, AF-GDB-021, AF-GDB-022, AF-GDB-023
